name: Lily's Babylon

evidence.note: Pub's events page lists Legendary Murphys on Sat Oct 3, 6-10 PM, and weekly happy-hour bands.
Local listing for a party band at Lily's invites people to come dance the night away.
Ticket page for Lily's After Dark club night, Sat Oct 3 from 10 PM, 18+ to enter.

dancing.notes: Party bands play early evening, and promoters invite people to dance. Later on weekend nights it runs 'Lily's After Dark' club nights for ages 18 and up with a cover charge.

description: A large Irish-American pub and restaurant on Deer Park Avenue in Babylon Village, formerly called Lily Flanagan's. It has happy-hour bands on Fridays and Saturdays and turns into a late-night club.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The 6 PM band and the 10 PM 18+ club night are different crowds. We did not find photos showing a dedicated dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook: the site links facebook.com/LilysBabylon/ (we use that vanity URL); the numeric page id 232718040167311 in our data is what Bing lists and is most likely the same page, but we could not open Facebook to confirm. Hours: the site footer/structured data say Wed-Thu 3-11 PM, Fri 3 PM-2 AM, Sat 12 PM-2 AM, Sun 12-10 PM; a separate text block on the same page says bar hours Fri-Sat 12 PM-2 AM and Sun 12-9 PM (kitchen closes earlier). Bing shows later closing times. The logo is white on a transparent background, so it needs a dark background to show. Existing description still fits; kept.
hours: Wed-Thu 3 PM-11 PM; Fri 3 PM-2 AM; Sat 12 PM-2 AM; Sun 12 PM-10 PM; closed Mon-Tue
